channel.title: Full Fact - All content
channel.description: Full Fact is the UK’s independent fact checking charity

item.title: Not everyone on NHS waiting lists is ‘not able to work properly’
item.description: A claim from Labour’s deputy leader failed to account for the fact many waiting aren’t of working age, while a survey found only a minority of adults on a hospital waiting list said their work was affected.

item.title: Wes Streeting did not wear skirt to remembrance ceremony
item.description: The defence secretary was pictured wearing trousers at the National Service Of Remembrance at the Cenotaph. Images showing him wearing a skirt have been edited.

item.title: AI-generated video of England flag hung on building works shared online
item.description: A Facebook video that claims to show a large St George’s flag hung from scaffolding is AI-generated.

item.title: Facebook ad offers fake Tesco grocery package giveaway
item.description: A Facebook ad shares a video falsely claiming you can get free groceries from Tesco by signing up on their website. The video was made with AI and isn’t a genuine offer from the retailer.

item.title: No, Andy Burnham has not just announced the UK is rejoining the EU
item.description: A Facebook video claims Andy Burnham has announced the UK is rejoining the EU. No such announcement has been made.

item.title: Videos of tradesmen supporting van driver told to remove England flag are AI-generated
item.description: Videos shared on Facebook that appear to show tradesmen backing a driver or a plumber who was supposedly told to remove an England flag from his van are AI-generated.

item.title: MP wrong to claim one brand sold over seven million smart glasses in the UK last year
item.description: The independent MP Shockat Adam said more than seven million pairs were sold in the UK last year, but his office has now confirmed this was a global figure.

item.title: Viral video does not show new strain of Covid found in Northampton
item.description: The UKHSA said it has not received any notification of a new strain of Covid-19 being found anywhere in the UK.

item.title: Fake images of Donald Trump being carried after US midterm elections shared online
item.description: There are plenty of clues the pictures aren’t real but were generated with AI.

item.title: What’s the value of the UK’s trade with the US?
item.description: On LBC, environment secretary Dame Angela Eagle claimed the UK and US “do £2.5 billion of business together”—but the latest figures put the annual value of UK/US trade at over 100 times that.
